items.text: My Root chakra pays rent on time now — I am safe, supported, and grounded in real life, not just in quotes.
My Sacral chakra said ‘we’re done being dry’ — I allow joy, creativity, and healthy pleasure to flow through me.
My Solar Plexus is tired of dimmer switches — I give myself permission to shine confidently and take up space.
My Heart chakra not accepting low-vibration bookings — I attract and choose love that respects and uplifts me.
My Throat chakra is done whispering truth — I speak clearly, kindly, and confidently for myself.
My Third Eye refuses to be on airplane mode — I trust my intuition and inner vision to guide my choices.
My Crown chakra upgraded the Wi-Fi — I am connected to divine wisdom, guidance, and protection at all times.
